messages:
Ava: quick triage  post-launch SEO tasks for the benchmark blog + webinar. Need redirects, schema, internal links, and HubSpot routing. @Diego @Priya @Eoin can you take? :slightly_smiling_face:

Diego: will do. drop the old/new paths and i'll draft 301s + smoke tests.

Ava: main targets: /webinars/redwood-bench -> /blog/benchmark-redwood-2026; /signup/webinar -> /webinar/register; /resources/old-llm -> /resources/llm-serving-best-practices; legacy /utm/* links need pass-through.

Diego: nginx rewrite rules ready, example: rewrite ^/signup/webinar$ /webinar/register permanent; preserve query string when utm present. i'll open infra PR and include curl smoke tests.

Priya: SEO notes  primary KW: "inference platform latency optimization" secondary: "LLM inference cost". Meta for blog/webinar: "See how Redwood Inference cut per-token cost and improved p99 latency  webinar + benchmark" (keep ~155 chars).

Priya: schema (JSON-LD) recommendations: Event for webinar + FAQPage on the benchmark blog (3 Qs: latency, cost, deployment). This helps rich snippets.

Eoin: HubSpot routing: if utm_campaign contains "benchmark" then set lifecycle_stage=lead, tag=webinar, assign by region (US/EU/APAC). Need region_detect hidden form field + IP fallback. Confirm EU residency routing for enterprise leads.

Ava: Legal says EU enterprise leads must stay in EU pipeline. Diego, add hidden region_detect + fallback dropdown on the form.

Diego: done. form PR includes GTM event for utm_campaign and utm_medium.

Priya: internal linking plan: add 3 contextual links from resources hub -> webinar (anchor: "benchmarking inference"), update cluster hub with callout to the benchmark post, add breadcrumbs schema on blog.

Eoin: tracking checklist: ensure UTM preserved through redirects, GTM fires on /webinar/register, HubSpot captures hidden fields, conversion in GA4 and internal analytics.

Ava: timeline: schema/meta by EOD today, redirects + form changes by EOD tomorrow, HubSpot workflow + tests by Fri. I'll write the runbook and post in #launchsquad.

Diego: PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234  staging smoke tests: 301s returning, final pages 200, utm preserved.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: redirect-edge-rules -> staging at 2026-04-22T13:00Z. CI: pending.

Ava: great, thanks everyone. closing this triage, will check post-launch analytics tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
